title.narrative: Hunan Xiangjiang River Watershed Existing Solid Waste Comprehensive Treatment Project

description.narrative: The project will address urgent environmental and infrastructure needs associated with municipal solid waste (MSW) management in 10 counties and county-level cities in the Xiangjiang River watershed of Hunan Province. It is a milestone for the Asian Development Bank (ADB) because it will be the first in the PRC to focus solely on MSW management. It will also complement the government's efforts to align MSW services with sustainable development. It will support overall strategies to reduce the discharge of long-term pollutants in the Xiangjiang River watershed and has significant potential for wide replication.

Loan 3712: 98% of contracts awarded and 73% disbursed as of 14 Jul 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: To be evaluated by project completion.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jul 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48443/48443-002-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental Impact Assessments | Sep 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48443/48443-002-eia-en_10.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Mar 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48443/48443-002-rp-en_10.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Mar 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48443/48443-002-sddr-en_17.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48443/48443-002-smr-en_17.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 29 civil works and goods contracts were awarded, 3 individual consultants and 2 consulting firm were mobilized to support project implementation. The project implementation is generally on track despite the initial delay and impact of covid-19 from 2020 to 2022 . A 18 months loan closing extension from 31 Dec 2023 to 30 Jun 2025 is expected.
